decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The details submitted in respect of condition 17, as listed below are satisfactory, subject to the following additional condition:
17a.	The additional physical sound insulation measures as detailed in the 'Sound Insulation Assessment' report by Cass Allen (ref. LR01-14440) dated 19 May 2015, received 20 May 2015, shall be fully completed prior to the first occupation of the dwellings; and an electronic noise limiter device shall be installed in the public house to limit the maximum noise level of amplified, musical and electronic equipment to a maximum of 90dBA, with such a limiter to be installed prior to the first occupation of the dwellings and maintained permanently thereafter. 

Schedule of supporting information
Condition 17 (noise)
Schedule of supporting information
Proposed Sound Insulation Measures by Acoustic Plus (ref. 102257a.ad Issue 1) dated 9 August 2012, received 19 October 2012

Sound Insulation Assessment by Cass Allen (ref. LR01-14440) dated 19 May 2015, received 20 May 2015

Letter from Gunnersbury Instant Karma Ltd dated 2 June 2015, received 5 June 2015, setting out agreement for the installation of an electronic noise limiter and noise control measures as specified in the Sound Insulation Assessment by Cass Allen (19 May 2015).
description: Details submitted pursuant to the discharge of condition  17 (scheme for insulation against noise emissions) of planning permission 00248/590/P11 approved 30.03.12 for the partial demolition of single storey rear wing and addition of 1st and 2nd storey extension, alterations to provide two x one bed, two x two bed and one x three bed maisonettes and erection of four 2-storey houses to the rear
